feature: SharedChannel abandoned-job prune load fast path

candidate.design: pruneAbandonedLocked now performs an acquire load of abandoned_pending and returns before the acq_rel swap when the flag is clear. abandon() stores the flag and re-enters unlock, so a concurrent abandonment is still observed by the next prune.

scope.workload: SharedChannel shared-unary persistent round trip, 262144-byte request and response

benchmark_method.schedule: five ABBA rounds; baseline, candidate, candidate, baseline
benchmark_method.host: shared host with unrelated load; no CPU pinning
benchmark_method.metric: ns_per_roundtrip from the benchmark result record

correctness.full_validation_run: shared-unary with full payload equality passed

context.note: The shared unary path remains about 1.69x the ordinary unary path; the accepted change reduces the worker lock/unlock overhead but does not close that architectural gap.
